framing.lineOfInquiry: Naveen Khanna (P00156) may have been involved in the incident recorded in CASE006
framing.alternate: Naveen Khanna (P00156) was not involved — the evidence has an innocent explanation
framing.note: KRONOS starts from the presumption of innocence. The line of inquiry and the alternates are tested against the same records; neither is a finding, and the strengths are not probabilities.

alternateHypotheses.title: Named or given a role in error
alternateHypotheses.statement: Naveen Khanna was named in the FIR, or assigned a role, without an independent basis.
alternateHypotheses.label: Weak

evidence.text: Recorded in the FIR as victim, not as accused
Recorded in the FIR as witness, not as accused

alternateHypotheses.test: Re-examine the FIR and statements; record the person's statement and the informant's basis for naming them.

alternateHypotheses.title: Was near the scene for a routine reason
alternateHypotheses.statement: Naveen Khanna was near the scene because they regularly go there (home, work, market), not because of the incident.
alternateHypotheses.label: Weak

evidence.text: Recorded within 1 km of the scene on 25 other days (12 Jan – 08 Mar), so presence there is part of their routine

alternateHypotheses.test: Establish why the person is regularly there (address, employment, shop) and compare the incident-time visit with their usual pattern (time of day, duration).

alternateHypotheses.title: Was elsewhere at the time (alibi)
alternateHypotheses.statement: Naveen Khanna was somewhere else when the incident happened.
alternateHypotheses.label: Weak

evidence.text: Recorded at Chandni Chowk Market, Delhi, 18.7 km from the scene, 69 min before the incident — the scene was reachable by road in that time, so this is only a partial alibi

alternateHypotheses.test: Verify the alibi record independently (CCTV, witnesses or receipts at that place and time) and check whether the device could have been carried by someone else.

alternateHypotheses.title: The contact was routine, not coordination
alternateHypotheses.statement: Naveen Khanna's calls and messages reflect a long-standing relationship (family, work, business), not planning of the incident.
alternateHypotheses.label: Weak

evidence.text: In contact with Manoj Singh since 2025-01-16, 22 days before the incident (6 calls, 6 messages) — a long-standing relationship

alternateHypotheses.test: Examine message content and the timing of contact relative to the incident; establish the relationship.

alternatesConsideredNotSupported.title: Someone else used the phone or handset
The money has a legitimate explanation

comparison.verdict: The line of inquiry is better supported (0.73 vs 0.35 for A6): 1 supporting item(s) are not explained by any alternate.
settleWith: A6 — Re-examine the FIR and statements; record the person's statement and the informant's basis for naming them.
A2 — Establish why the person is regularly there (address, employment, shop) and compare the incident-time visit with their usual pattern (time of day, duration).
A1 — Verify the alibi record independently (CCTV, witnesses or receipts at that place and time) and check whether the device could have been carried by someone else.
